Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Sonali - 39 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Kavya - 8 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
4. Naira - 13 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Sonali, Kavya and Naira stand near him.]

Sonali: "What lovely weather!"

[Nikhil walks across the courtyard.]

Nikhil: "Yes, of course."

[Nikhil jumps with joy.]

Naira: "Okay, Kavya."

[Nikhil thinks for a moment.]

Naira: "What happened?"

[Nikhil shouts angrily.]

Nikhil: "Hey, look at that!"

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Naira: "That's great!"

[The sun rises over the village.]

Sonali (happily): "This is amazing!"

[Nikhil milks the cow.]

Nikhil (laughing): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
